headline: Iranian Rial Plunges Following New US Sanctions
summary: The Iranian rial fell sharply on the black market after the US Treasury announced new sanctions targeting exchange houses and alleged shadow banking entities.
why: Sanctions on Iran's financial sector restrict its ability to conduct international trade and exacerbate domestic currency devaluation.

impacts.name: Iranian Rial
impacts.why: US sanctions restrict access to foreign currency and trade.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The imposition of new US sanctions on Iranian financial entities triggered a sharp devaluation of the currency on the black market.
